chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Do not travel on Monday, nor seek any need on that day."
ai.seo_question: Is it disliked to travel or seek one’s needs on Monday according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a discouragement from traveling or pursuing one’s needs on Monday. It reflects guidance concerning disliked times for travel and worldly undertakings within the transmitted Islamic tradition.
